literal_meaning: হৃদয়ে মৃত্যুবরণ করা (to die in the heart)
figurative_meaning_en: To feel extremely embarrassed or mortified
similar_in_english: Wish the ground would swallow one up
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ভুলের জন্য মরমে মরে গেল।
পরীক্ষায় খারাপ ফল পেয়ে ছেলেটি মরমে মরা গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: She died inwardly from embarrassment after spilling coffee on her boss.
He felt mortified and wished he could disappear after the faux pas.
note: This idiom vividly captures the internal emotional turmoil common in Bengali expressive language.
